name: Warforged Umbral Disciple forum case

errors: Level 17 / Sudden Leap: Requires 1 prior Tiger Claw maneuvers/stances
Level 17 / Dancing Mongoose: Requires 2 prior Tiger Claw maneuvers/stances
Level 17 / Pouncing Charge: Requires 2 prior Tiger Claw maneuvers/stances
Bonus Essentia is not repeatable; its benefit is counted once

build_errors: Level 18: Bonus Essentia: This feat cannot be selected more than once
Bonus Essentia is not repeatable; its benefit is counted once
Level 17 / Sudden Leap: Requires 1 prior Tiger Claw maneuvers/stances
Level 17 / Dancing Mongoose: Requires 2 prior Tiger Claw maneuvers/stances
Level 17 / Pouncing Charge: Requires 2 prior Tiger Claw maneuvers/stances
assumptions: The post supplies no ability scores, alignment or skill-spending history. Probe CON 14 and NG are explicit assumptions, not recovered facts; prestige entry and feat prerequisites are not certified.
The repair removes the second Bonus Essentia and replaces Dancing Mongoose with Wolf Fang Strike, learned before Sudden Leap and Pouncing Charge. Level 18's replacement feat remains unchosen.
Two light manufactured weapons, medium Warforged, speed 30, active Ranger TWF style and Gloves from level 12; slam availability is explicitly selectable. No shield is used by this full-attack probe.
Kiss extends reach only on your own turn. Target distance is distance at the attack, not charge movement; flanking must use the adjacent-square rule.
Natural attacks, actual hit damage and saving throws need explicit adjudication/rolls. Attack rows are opportunities, not automatic hits or automatic sneak attacks.
Only the four named soulmelds and this action chain execute here. Other class features retain complete level descriptions but are not all encounter resolvers.
